desc: Derive the allowed interval \([\,\max(0,H-D_i),\min(U_i,H)\,]\) for each final upper tooth and justify the lower-tooth constraints.
Implement fixed-\(H\) feasibility by propagating the reachable interval through adjacent difference constraints of at most \(X\).
Prove feasibility is monotone as \(H\) decreases, enabling binary search for the maximum feasible height.
Calculate the minimum cost as \(\sum_i(U_i+D_i)-NH\) using Python arbitrary-precision integers.
Produce the final stdin/stdout Python solution in the requested code delimiters and verify all sample cases.
